title: DeepSeek-V3 joins the text models
summary:
DeepSeek-V3 joined the text model list, alongside persona and response-handling changes.

Added DeepSeek-V3 as `deepseek`, with generation routed through DeepSeek’s API or OpenRouter. `mistral-large` and `command-r` were removed from the listed models.

The Midijourney persona now uses OpenAI instead of Claude, while the Evil persona uses Mistral instead of Command-R.

The OpenAI search response limit rose from 1,024 to 4,096 tokens, and the delay after both successful and failed text responses changed to three seconds.
